title: Baasha
desc: Bound by a promise to his late father, a gangster becomes an autorickshaw driver. However, when his past catches up with him, he must choose between succumbing to his old ways and keeping his word.

title: Rowdy Rakshak
desc: A special agent is assigned to protect the prime minister, who later gets assassinated. He is tasked with finding the group responsible for the assassination.

title: Himmatwar
desc: The son of a wealthy man leaves his family post a misunderstanding. Later, when he saves a police officer from an evil man, this results in him earning the latter's wrath.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: Shalini, a former nursing student from Kerala, who later becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifies her life story and her journey from being a naive girl to another victim of terrorism.

title: Kaatera
desc: Kaatera, a blacksmith from a village named Bheemanahalli, goes through numerous threats so that a reform act gets implemented which gives freedom to the farmers from feudal landlords.
